programs.name: Pathway to Master of Urban Management and Planning

academic.text: Be completing the final 40 credit points or less of the 1732 Bachelor of Planning (Pathway to Master of Urban Management and Planning).
academic.quote: To be eligible you need to be completing your final 40 credit points or less in 1732 Bachelor of Planning (Pathway to Master of Urban Management and Planning).

prerequisites.text: Be completing the final 40 credit points or less of the Bachelor of Planning pathway program.
prerequisites.quote: To be eligible you need to be completing your final 40 credit points or less in 1732 Bachelor of Planning (Pathway to Master of Urban Management and Planning).

academic.text: Complete studies in your first degree that meet the qualification standards set by the NSW Education Standards Authority.
academic.quote: You need to complete studies in your first degree that meet the qualification standards set by the NSW Education Standards Authority.

prerequisites.text: Must attempt the National Literacy and Numeracy Test for Initial Teacher Education (LANTITE) within the first year of the Master's program.
prerequisites.quote: Must attempt the National Literacy and Numeracy Test for Initial Teacher Education (LANTITE), within the first year of the Master's program.

prerequisites.text: Must satisfactorily reach the required standard (band 2) in LANTITE before enrolling in the final professional experience placement.
prerequisites.quote: You must satisfactorily reach the required standard (band 2) in the National Literacy and Numeracy Test for Initial Teacher Education before enrolling in your final professional experience placement.
